quotes.text: Slowly lower your body towards the floor while maintaining a rigid torso and head aligned with your spine. Do not allow your low back to sag or your hips to hike upwards during this downward phase.

quotes.text: Slowly lift your entire torso off the floor or mat, maintaining a stiff torso and legs. Avoid any arching (sagging) in your low back, hiking (upwards) in your hips or bending in the knees.

quotes.text: Only raise the limbs to heights where the low back position can be maintained through the combined actions of the core and abdominal muscles.
